_comment: Mynewt triage suitability, scored on verdict only. Case IDs are PR numbers; records are candidates/mynewt/enriched/<pr>.json.
Accepts are the three checked-in instances, generated from triage/mynewt_reviewed/<pr>.json and validated 3/3 (fail before, pass after, exact testcase inventory).

Rejects come from docs/mynewt_bad_prs.md (2157, 3509) and mynewt-benchmark-expansion/REPORT.md's screened list (1702, 3381); they are diff/metadata judgments, not validator traces. 3509 is a validated regression rejected only for having no linked issue.

hard_filter_reject PRs never reach the model: filter_candidates.py drops them because they change no selftest package. They are checked by `filter_candidates.py selftest --repo mynewt`, not scored here. 251 is a validated regression, but its test lives in a pre-selftest test/ package.

reject.2157: Selftest changes only drop a removed syscfg setting; no testcase detects the production change
reject.3509: No linked originating issue; the PR references another PR instead
reject.1702: The only selftest change is reformatting a helper; no testcase detects the fix, and no linked issue
reject.3381: Selftest changes only initialize local variables; no assertion detects the fix, and no linked issue

hard_filter_reject.2511: No selftest changed; apps/pwm_test is a demo application
hard_filter_reject.821: No selftest changed; hardware PWM demo
hard_filter_reject.251: Test is under encoding/cborattr/test, not a selftest package
